test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 30 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Dwiti is an immediate neighbour of both Durga and Dheeraj. Dilip is sitting second to the right of Dwiti. Dev is sitting third to the left of Dheeraj. Dilip is an immediate neighbour of both Daksh and Dheeraj. Who is an immediate neighbour of both Daksh and Durga?
solution:
Given: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Dilip is sitting second to the right of Dwiti.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b10a2f13b12e054d07ea960976b2e217c7c33be66e54226884040a9bec5daae9.png] 

2) Dwiti is an immediate neighbour of both Durga and Dheeraj. 

3) Dev is sitting third to the left of Dheeraj.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ffca8c29be1d470a493280b936d2fc6b185edc9f71e3e0c1bcfb6dd3f266a06.png] 

4) Dilip is an immediate neighbour of both Daksh and Dheeraj.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6446eb4afc6a0c9decb3c97f0cb4548d765372a884f39c4a35867bcd25aecec2.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Dev is an immediate neighbour of both Daksh and Durga.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
